description: Complete mobile responsive polish: fix overflowing elements, broken stacking, cramped cards, weak tap targets, inconsistent font sizing, and layout drift on all breakpoints. All rules added to the visual-final-polish.css file.
steps: Add mobile typography corrections to visual-final-polish.css for breakpoint <=640px: (1) .landing-title font-size clamp(28px, 7vw, 36px). (2) .landing-features-title font-size clamp(22px, 5.5vw, 28px). (3) .landing-final-cta-title font-size clamp(22px, 5vw, 32px). (4) .landing-subtitle and .landing-final-cta-lede font-size 14px with line-height 1.6. (5) .dash-section-title font-size var(--fs-lg). (6) .welcome-card .page-title font-size clamp(20px, 5vw, 24px). (7) .metric-value font-size clamp(20px, 4vw, 26px). (8) All body text on mobile min font-size 14px for readability.

Add mobile layout fixes for breakpoint <=640px: (1) .landing-cta-glass must stack vertically (flex-direction: column, width: 100%) so buttons don't overflow. (2) .landing-hero must stack (grid-template-columns: 1fr) with text centered. (3) .landing-ai-grid must stack (grid-template-columns: 1fr). (4) .dash-hero-row must stack (grid-template-columns: 1fr). (5) .dash-quick-stats must reduce to 2 columns (grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr)). (6) .kpi-strip must wrap properly (flex-wrap: wrap). (7) .landing-trust-bar-inner must stack vertically. (8) .owner-action-bar must wrap (flex-wrap: wrap, gap: var(--sp-2)).

Add mobile spacing and padding corrections for breakpoint <=480px: (1) .landing-shell padding-inline: var(--sp-3). (2) .card padding: var(--sp-3). (3) .metric padding: var(--sp-3). (4) .page-header padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4). (5) .dash-agenda-item padding: var(--sp-3). (6) .welcome-card padding: var(--sp-5) var(--sp-4). (7) .landing-final-cta padding: var(--sp-6) var(--sp-3). (8) .auth-glass-card padding: var(--sp-4).

Add tap target enforcement for all breakpoints with (pointer: coarse): (1) All .btn, .pill, .tab, .nav-item, .filter-pill, .role-tab minimum 44px height and min-width where applicable. (2) .icon-btn minimum 44px x 44px. (3) .bottom-nav-item minimum 52px height. (4) .topbar-notif minimum 44px x 44px. (5) .landing-nav a minimum padding 12px for adequate touch area. (6) .sidebar-logout minimum 44px x 44px.

Fix mobile overflow issues: (1) .kpi-strip on mobile must have overflow-x: auto with -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch if content exceeds viewport. (2) .landing-hero-showcase on mobile must have overflow: hidden to prevent float cards from extending past viewport. (3) .topbar-search on mobile <=600px must be display: none (already done in responsive.css but reinforce). (4) .tbl-wrap on mobile must have scroll-snap-type: x proximity for better scroll UX. (5) .filter-bar on mobile must scroll horizontally without breaking layout. (6) .landing-bento on mobile <=640px must be single column.

Fix bottom navigation spacing conflicts: (1) Ensure .content padding-bottom accounts for bottom-nav height (72px + safe-area). (2) Ensure .landing page doesn't show bottom-nav overlap (it shouldn't have bottom-nav, but verify z-index layering). (3) On <=640px where bottom-nav is visible, ensure no FAB or fixed element conflicts with the nav.

Add responsive refinements for tablet breakpoint 641px-1024px: (1) .landing-hero grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr with reduced gap (var(--sp-6)). (2) .grid-4 becomes 2 columns. (3) .grid-3 becomes 2 columns. (4) .sidebar width: min(280px, 80vw) on tablet. (5) .landing-bento stays 2 columns. (6) .dash-quick-stats stays 4 columns but with smaller gap (var(--sp-3)).

Add RTL-specific mobile fixes: (1) Ensure .sidebar transform uses translateX(100%) for RTL slide-in from right edge. (2) Ensure .page-header::before accent rail is on inset-inline-start (which is right in RTL). (3) Ensure .topbar-scope text-overflow works in RTL direction. (4) Ensure .landing-cta-glass .btn icons don't flip incorrectly on mobile RTL. (5) Ensure .metric-icon stays on the correct side in RTL mobile layouts.
acceptance_criteria: No text overflows the viewport on any screen size from 320px to 1440px
All interactive elements meet 44px minimum touch target on touch devices
Cards and grid layouts properly stack on mobile without content being cut off
Typography is readable at all breakpoints (min 14px body text on mobile)
Bottom navigation does not overlap content
RTL layout works correctly on all mobile breakpoints
Horizontal scroll does not appear on any page unless intentional (tables, filter bars)
verification: Read visual-final-polish.css and verify all media queries use correct breakpoints matching responsive.css patterns
Verify no conflicting !important overrides that would break existing responsive.css rules
Check that RTL selectors are logically correct (inset-inline-start/end, not left/right)
